_about: Human-reviewed ground truth for the multi-camera restaurant VLM eval (27 Sep 2026). Frames in ./frames. people = [min,max] acceptable count of visible persons incl. partial (hands/arms/legs). hazards = keyword groups a good answer must mention (any word in the group counts). Descriptions are what a careful human sees; judge scores answers against them. Counts for line/dining/salamander/plating were widened on 27 Sep after a full-resolution recount (thumbnail labels undercounted the far-end staff cluster and diners beyond the glass).

crownshy.label: Crown Shy (NYC) dinner service, 7 fixed cameras, 1080p, source: Bon Appetit '19 cameras' film
crownshy.context: Fine-dining restaurant with an open kitchen during evening service.

crownshy-line.area: hot line / main kitchen, wide high-angle view down the cooking line, dining room visible through glass at the far end

frames.desc: Wide view down the hot line at night. One cook in a dark shirt and grey apron stands at the left counter mid-line; three to four more staff (one in a white chef jacket) work at the far end; diners are visible beyond the glass wall. Trays of raw chicken pieces sit uncovered on the near-left counter, pots on the stove, a flat-top griddle in the middle. No customers inside the kitchen.

Same wide hot-line view. A cook in dark shirt and apron walks along the left side of the line; three or four staff at the far end near the pass; diners behind the glass. Raw chicken pieces on trays on the near counter, pots on the range, griddle.
Same view. A cook stands at the left counter over a pot; several staff at the far end; diners beyond the glass. Raw chicken trays near the camera, pans on the stove.

crownshy-dining.area: dining room / chef's counter looking into the open kitchen under heat lamps

frames.desc: Guests seated at the counter facing the open kitchen: a man in a checked shirt, a woman with long hair laughing, more guests at the edges. Behind the counter a tall bearded chef in a white jacket and dark apron stands at the pass; two more cooks work at the back. Black heat lamps hang over the pass. Service in progress, relaxed mood.

Counter seating with four guests (checked-shirt man, two women, one more at the edge) facing the open kitchen; bearded chef in white at the pass, two cooks at the back, a man in a white chef jacket at the right. Heat lamps over the pass, a framed poster on the right wall.

Same: four to five guests at the counter, bearded chef standing at the pass, cook in a cap at the back, another cook in white, a fourth staff member at the right. Framed portrait poster on the right wall. Service in progress.

crownshy-prep.area: prep kitchen (back of house), eye-level view of a steel prep table with a combi oven behind

frames.desc: Three cooks in black tees, caps and white aprons at a steel prep table processing carrots: the left one peels a carrot with a red peeler, the middle one (blond) makes julienne/shredded carrot on a board, the right one (glasses, tattooed forearm) peels with gloves. Whole carrots in a tray, a knife on the board, a blue glove box, a combi oven behind. Bare hands on the left cook.
Same three cooks at the prep table: left peeling a carrot, middle shredding carrots into a pile, right peeling. Tray of carrots, knife on the cutting board, gloves on some hands but not all.
Same three cooks prepping carrots at the steel table; middle cook talking while working; knife on the board; tray of carrots; combi oven behind.

Overhead view of a charcoal grill with meat cooking over an open flame; a chef in a white jacket stands at the grill holding tongs, a second person in a dark apron walks past at the right edge, a blurred third person at the bottom left. A foil-lined tray beside the grill.
Side view: a bearded chef in a white jacket and apron works a pan on the range with a flame flaring from the pan; pots and pans around, another person partly visible behind him.
Overhead view of the charcoal grill with a large flame flare-up; the chef in white stands at the right holding tongs over the fire. Foil tray beside the grill.

crownshy-plancha.area: plancha / flat-top griddle station, overhead camera

frames.desc: Overhead of a flat-top griddle with octopus tentacles, cubes of pink pork or ham and yellow squash cubes cooking; a blurred hand at the left; other cooks tiny in the background at the far station.
Same griddle; a gloved hand places a piece of meat on the plancha next to the octopus, pork cubes and squash; a cook is visible far away at the top.
Same griddle; a gloved hand sets down a piece of short rib; octopus, pork cubes and squash cubes cooking; a cook at the far station in the background.

crownshy-salamander.area: salamander / finishing station, overhead camera looking down on a cook's head

frames.desc: Overhead: a cook in a black shirt (dark hair, seen from above) works at a steel station under two salamander broilers; trays of sauces, plates, bowls and a squeeze bottle in front of him; a hand or cloth at the right edge.
Same overhead view; the cook in black at the station, another person's arm in a dark apron reaches in at the right; sauces and bowls laid out.
Same station from above; the main cook has stepped out of the centre; a cook at the right in a black shirt holds a cloth; trays, bowls and sauces on the counter.

crownshy-plating.area: the pass, overhead camera over a dark marble counter with heat lamps

frames.desc: Overhead of the pass: plated dishes (tostada-like with lettuce and orange sauce), boards with cut meat, tickets/papers, a timer, black heat lamps; hands of about three people (one plating at the top, one at the bottom, one at the right).
Same pass: two people at the top, one in gloves handling a board of cut meat, one bare-handed with bracelets garnishing a plate; plated dishes lined up; tickets at the bottom.
Same pass: a gloved person at the top wrapping or handling meat on a board, hands at the right garnishing, plated dishes with lettuce and orange sauce, heat lamps, papers.

multicam.desc: All seven cameras show one fine-dining restaurant during an evening service: hot line busy with 4-8 staff, guests seated at the chef's counter (service in progress), a prep kitchen with three cooks processing carrots, a charcoal grill with open flames, a plancha with octopus and pork, a salamander finishing station, and the pass with plates being finished. The busiest areas are the hot line and the pass. Issues: open-flame flare-ups at the grill, raw chicken uncovered on the line, some bare-hand food contact in prep and plating.

kitchen.label: EPFL Smart Kitchen, 5 synchronised cameras, 720p source, one cook, frames at t=60s, 150s, 240s
kitchen.context: A small institutional kitchen with a single cook preparing a meal; faces are blurred in the source footage.

kitchen-overview.area: whole room from a high corner by the door

frames.desc: Small grey kitchen seen from a high corner. One person (grey t-shirt, dark skirt, dark hair) stands at the far counter by the window, back to the camera. Empty prep counter and sink in the foreground with a cucumber and an orange near the sink.
Same room; the same person stands at the far counter by the window working on something; foreground counter empty.
Same room; the person is now at the near counter/sink in the bottom centre, bending over and holding a pan or bowl.

kitchen-wide.area: long view down the counters from the far end toward the door

frames.desc: Long view down the kitchen toward the glass door. One person in a grey t-shirt and dark skirt stands at the left counter holding a box or packet; boxes, bottles and a plastic bag on the counter; bin by the wall.
Same long view; the person is now right below the camera in the foreground (head and shoulders, back turned) at the near counter; nobody elsewhere.
Same long view; the person stands at the sink in the centre of the room, working over it.

kitchen-stove.area: induction hob and the corner counter, high angle

frames.desc: High view over a small induction hob with an empty pan on it; the person in a grey t-shirt stands at the counter to the right holding a white box; oil bottles and a knife block on the counter.
Same view; only the person's torso is visible at the top edge; the pan sits empty on the hob; bottles and a blue packet on the counter.
Same view; the person is at the top left over the sink; pan still on the hob; counter items unchanged.

kitchen-prep.area: chopping board and sink from directly above

frames.desc: Top-down view of a chopping board and sink: a knife, a cucumber, an aubergine/eggplant and an orange on the board; a green container; a pair of legs visible in the doorway at the top. No cutting happening.
Same top-down view; knife, cucumber, aubergine and orange on the board, a white cloth or paper added; legs in the doorway at the top.
Same top-down view; the cook's arm and torso reach over the sink from the top holding a pan; a cut yellow pepper on the board, the knife and cucumber moved; work in progress.

kitchen-sink.area: sink and back counter from the side

frames.desc: Side view of the sink area; the person in a grey t-shirt stands at the counter on the right holding a white box; dish rack with plates, bottles, a bowl in the foreground.
Same view; the person at the right side of the counter, arm outstretched toward the sink; dish rack, bottles.
Same view; the person stands at the sink in the centre; dish rack, bottles, a bowl in front.

multicam.desc: Five cameras cover one small kitchen with a single cook (grey t-shirt, dark skirt). At the reference moment she is at the sink/near counter; the hob has an empty pan; a knife, cucumber, aubergine and orange are on the chopping board. No service, no customers, one person total.

temporal.kitchen-overview: The cook moves from the far counter by the window (frames 1-2) to the near sink area (frame 3).
temporal.kitchen-wide: The cook goes from the left counter holding a box, to right under the camera in the foreground, to the sink in the centre.
temporal.kitchen-stove: The cook is at the right counter with a box, then only her torso shows at the top, then she is at the top-left sink; the pan stays empty on the hob throughout.
temporal.kitchen-prep: Board with whole cucumber, aubergine, orange and a knife; a cloth appears; then a cut yellow pepper and the cook's arm with a pan over the sink.
temporal.kitchen-sink: The cook stays around the sink counter: holding a box at the right, reaching to the sink, then standing at the sink.
